definition: The pleasant, earthy scent that frequently accompanies the first rain after a long period of warm, dry weather.
sentence1: The sudden summer storm released a rich petrichor across the parched valley. (The sudden summer storm released a rich petrichor across the parched valley.)
sentence2: She paused on her morning walk to breathe in the soothing petrichor rising from the damp earth. (She paused on her morning walk to breathe in the soothing petrichor rising from the damp earth.)

definition: Pertaining to the early morning mist and sunrise over the dewy meadows.
sentence1: El brillo matutino iluminaba las hojas cubiertas de rocío en el bosque. (The morning glow illuminated the dew-covered leaves in the forest.)
sentence2: Disfrutamos de la brisa fresca del ambiente matutino antes de que saliera el sol. (We enjoyed the fresh breeze of the morning atmosphere before the sun came out.)

definition: A gentle, atmospheric autumn mist or very fine drizzle that soft-focuses the landscape.
sentence1: Une douce bruine automnale enveloppait les vieux arbres du parc parisien. (A gentle autumn drizzle enveloped the old trees of the Parisian park.)
sentence2: Le paysage semblait mystérieux sous la fine bruine de novembre. (The landscape seemed mysterious under the fine November drizzle.)

definition: The profound feeling of being alone in the woods and connected to nature.
sentence1: Er fand tiefe Ruhe und Waldeinsamkeit auf dem schattigen Pfad. (He found deep peace and forest solitude on the shady path.)
sentence2: Die magische Waldeinsamkeit half ihr, den Stress des Alltags zu vergessen. (The magical forest solitude helped her to forget the stress of everyday life.)

definition: The sunlight filtering through the leaves of trees, creating a dappled pattern.
sentence1: Mori no naka o aruku to, utsukushii komorebi ga ashimoto o terashite ita. (When walking in the forest, beautiful sunlight filtering through leaves illuminated my feet.)
sentence2: Komorebi no naka de odayaka na kaze ga fite iru. (A calm breeze is blowing amidst the sunlight filtering through the trees.)

definition: The peak springtime season when mountain wildflowers burst into vibrant color.
sentence1: La splendida fioritura primaverile ha trasformato la valle in un tappeto di colori. (The magnificent spring bloom transformed the valley into a carpet of colors.)
sentence2: Fotografi da tutto il mondo visitano le colline durante la fioritura di maggio. (Photographers from all over the world visit the hills during the May bloom.)

definition: The subtle, refreshing fragrance of blooming blossoms carried on a spring breeze.
sentence1: Chuntian de zaoqi, yuanzi li chongman le muxu de qingxiang. (In the early spring morning, the courtyard was filled with the subtle fragrance of jasmine.)
sentence2: Zai lingchen de fengzhong, women wen dao le caodi de qingxiang. (In the dawn breeze, we smelled the fresh fragrance of the grassland.)

definition: The golden glow and lingering warmth of the sun setting over an autumn horizon.
sentence1: Ga eul jeonyeok noeureum i san deul eul bu reu geh mul deul li go it da. (The autumn evening sunset glow is warmly dyeing the mountains.)
sentence2: Geu neun chang ga e an ja sin bi han noeureum eul ba ra boat da. (She sat by the window and gazed at the mysterious sunset glow.)

definition: The peaceful twilight hour as evening mist settles over the tropical countryside.
sentence1: Pel prorlop, thngai lich sabaey nas nov leuk phnom. (During twilight, the sunset is very peaceful over the mountain.)
sentence2: Prey phnom nov pel prorlop mean klang phseng phat. (The forest at twilight has a cool breeze blowing.)

definition: The crisp, invigorating chill in the air right before the onset of a winter frost.
sentence1: Die skerp koue van die winteroggend laat die gras blink met ryp. (The sharp chill of the winter morning makes the grass glisten with frost.)
sentence2: Ons het heerlik gekuier om die vuur terwyl die koue buite toesak. (We enjoyed gathering around the fire while the chill settled outside.)
